---
title: "Class Notes 10-16"
format: html
---

```{r}
library(nflreadr)
library(tidyverse)
fantasy2025_wr <- load_player_stats(2025, summary_level = "reg") |>
  dplyr::filter(position %in% c("WR")) |>
  select(player_display_name,recent_team,position,games,
         carries,rushing_yards,rushing_tds,
         receptions,targets,receiving_yards,receiving_tds,
         fantasy_points_ppr)|>
  as.data.frame() |>
  dplyr::filter(games>=14,fantasy_points_ppr>=30) 

cb_palette = c(
  "#000000",  # black
  "#E69F00",  # orange
  "#56B4E9",  # sky blue
  "#009E73",  # bluish green
  "#F0E442",  # yellow
  "#0072B2",  # blue
  "#D55E00",  # vermillion
  "#CC79A7"   # reddish purple
)
glimpse(fantasy2025_wr)
```

```{r}
rownames(fantasy2025_wr)=fantasy2025_wr$player_display_name
wr_clust=hclust(dist(scale(fantasy2025_wr[,4:12])),
                method="complete")
plot(wr_clust,hang=-1,cex=0.3)
```

```{r}
library(factoextra)
fviz_dend(wr_clust,
          k=8,
          color_labels_by_k = TRUE,
          palette=cb_palette,
          type="circular",
          repel = TRUE,
          cex=0.5)
```
